fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Gematria and the Number 111", "body": "One of the hosts explained that the Hebrew word aleph spelled out equals 111, and traced that number through the episode: the young girl in the elevator, Ouroboros as a priest of the Lord, the hallway numbers 11 through 99, and the word for ohm. The same host said the 11 through 99 sequence added up to 495 and that 495 matched a Hebrew phrase for dust of the ground in Genesis. A viewer in the chat noted that 495 divided by 11 gives 45, the value of Adam, and the hosts tied that to the Enneagram. They treated these as patterns they noticed in the episode."}, {"title": "The Divine Wind and the Windbag Fool", "body": "One of the hosts argued that the Fool card carried a bag of wind, and linked Loki's landing in a mail truck, the pneumatic tubes and the name Ouroboros to words for spirit and breath such as aura, pneuma, psyche, spiritus and ruach. That host read passages from the author Nimrod and listed Bible verses about wind and breath. He also described Loki's time slipping as metempsychosis, a soul cycling through ages, and said the season followed Loki breaking out of that wheel."}, {"title": "Wheels, Crucifixion and the Phoenix", "body": "Chance described the Iynx wheel, Hecate's wheel and Ixion on the wheel as symbols he read as crucifixion, a sacrifice by oneself to oneself, and tied them to the Hunger Games mockingjay and the word jinx, asking Gabe about the jinx game. Later, as Loki pruned himself with the time stick, one of the hosts called it a phoenix moment, and Gabe noticed that the ringing phone and the word phoenix share a sound, which Chance thanked him for. The hosts framed all of this as their own symbolic reading of the series."}, {"title": "Gabe's Enneagram and Tarot Weaves", "body": "Gabe tied the episode to his Enneagram work throughout. He said the villain looked like Machiavelli, whom he called his number three Empress card on the Slick Dissident channel, and he described Ouroboros's cauldron table as a chef's workstation with the onion as a key ingredient. He said Robert Sapolsky's talk of hormones fit his view that the Enneagram was the endocrine system, and he pointed out that the code number 1127 read like Y2K in reverse and like 911. Other parts of the show added Hebrew letter and tarot correspondences."}, {"title": "Spaghettification, Black Holes and Fiction", "body": "One of the hosts described spaghettification as a fictional idea and argued that black holes moved from science fiction to accepted belief, saying the photographs shown were not proof to him. The same host linked the Latin spaga, meaning string, to space, and mentioned the Flying Spaghetti Monster. Gabe said that if the linchpin of the black hole story were pulled out, the whole industry behind it would fall. Chance tied the temple as an open space for observing time to Einstein's ideas about space and time."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Tonight we continue our decode of Marvel's Loki series, with the rest of Season 2, Episode 1: Ouroboros. It's a doozy with more to say about 111 and the Fool card, the divine spirit & breath of God, the ancient motif of the crucified savior, the fiction of Black Holes and spaghettification, the mystery of the letter A (Aleph, Alpha, etc.), and a whole lot more. This content will be fascinating and educational even for those who never watched the TV series that we're decoding, so don't miss out!
